# Legacy Life Builder

A digitized personal operating system for multi-year goal management, habit formation, and weekly planning. It replaces traditional books, spreadsheets, and manual progress checking by using AI to synchronize objectives with real-life timelines.

## Core Mechanics and Capabilities

- [Routines](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/routines): Establishes permanent sleep schedules and habits to eliminate manual weekly re-entry.
- [Capture Space](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/capture): Provides a dedicated capture space for instant knowledge storage, allowing later integration to reduce daily brain drain.
- [Scheduling](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/scheduling): AI calculates the required hours for weekly targets and automatically allocates time to empty calendar slots.
- [Time-Boxing](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/time-boxing): Enforces a minimum 30-minute block for deep work, strictly preventing unrealistic overlapping tasks.
- [Goals](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/goals): Automatically breaks down massive 10-year goals into actionable weekly sub-goals.

## System Analytics

- [Analytics](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/analytics): Monitors user consistency, working capacity, and habit adherence with empirical data.
- [Personalization](https://www.legacylifebuilder.xyz/personalization): Constructs plans based exclusively on the user's focus capacity, task-shifting ability, and learning speed.
